CustomField.description: SFDC-366. Unit of Measure chosen by the rep for this line, picked from the product's default QuantityUnitOfMeasure plus Product2.Allowed_UoM__c. BLANK MEANS THE LINE INHERITS Product2.QuantityUnitOfMeasure - every reader must coalesce, never read this field on its own. Blank is the state of every line created before SFDC-366. One UoM per ramp family: all phases of a ramped line share the parent's value, because deleteRampPhases sums phase quantities back onto the parent when unramping.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Unit this line's quantity is expressed in. Changing it does not recalculate quantity or price. Blank means the product's own unit is used.
CustomField.label: UoM
